implementation_notes: A `contracts` module owned by both teams, published together with both consumers in one CI run. Use Spring's contract-first testing or Pact so the joint integration suite fails fast.
idiom_name: contracts module + one CI run publishing both consumers
code_sketch:
<dependencyManagement>
  <dependency> com.acme:contracts:${contract.version} </dependency>
</dependencyManagement>
// CI publishes contracts + both consumers together
pitfalls: A contracts module that quietly became a shared domain model
Each team releasing against a different contracts version
